name: GELSEN-NET Gerhardstraße Data Center
notes: DataCenterMap lists a GELSEN-NET data center in Gelsenkirchen; GELSEN-NET's own site says it operates its own data centers in the Ruhr area. No public IT load found.

name: Arvato Systems DC1 and DC3 Gütersloh
notes: TÜV SÜD certificate names Arvato Systems Rechenzentrum DC1 und DC3 at Reinhard-Mohn-Straße 18, 33333 Gütersloh. Capacity not public.

name: BITel Business Service Housing / Telehouse Gütersloh
notes: BITel describes a certified regional data center and identifies its Business Service Housing (Rechenzentrum Telehouse) in Gütersloh; no public MW disclosed.

name: Stadt Hagen replacement secondary data center
notes: City flood-recovery application lists 'Ersatzneubau Zweit-Rechenzentrum' at Rathausstr. 1-11 after the city hall data center was destroyed by flooding; budget shown as EUR 7.65m. No MW public.

name: Blackstone / QTS Westfalen Data Center Campus near Hamm-Uentrop and Lippetal
developer: Blackstone / Quality Technology Services (QTS) with Industriegebiet Westfalen GmbH
notes: City of Hamm says a conditional purchase agreement enables development of a campus a few hundred meters from the Hamm-Uentrop A2 junction on Lippetal territory, with 200 MW planned IT computing power. Cross-boundary industrial-area project is relevant to Hamm division.

name: Gangelt Data Center Industrial Park campus
notes: Reports say Gangelt council approved a 20-hectare special area named Gewerbepark/Data Center Industrial Park on the L47, potentially up to 13 buildings of about 6,300 sqm each plus a substation. Later local reporting noted power-connection uncertainty; MW not public.

name: DTS DataCenter Herford
notes: DTS states its own high-performance data centers in Herford and Münster are the core of its DTS Cloud services; DataCenterMap lists the Herford site at Schrewestraße 2. Capacity not public.

name: YEXIO Herne Data Center at FunkenbergQuartier
developer: HOCHTIEF PPP Solutions / Palladio Partners / Yorizon
notes: HOCHTIEF announced groundbreaking; facility is initially 2 MW IT capacity with expansion potential to 4 MW, scheduled for completion in autumn 2027.

name: GLASFASER RUHR / TMR Rechenzentrum Herne
developer: Telekommunikation Mittleres Ruhrgebiet GmbH / GLASFASER RUHR
notes: GLASFASER RUHR describes a TÜV Saarland-audited Herne colocation data center; Herne's 2018 participation report referenced expansion of data center space at the Herne DataCenter location. No public MW found.

name: Telekom / T-Systems Krefeld data center
notes: DataCenter-Insider describes the Telekom data center in Krefeld, built in the 1980s, using a classic redundant data center layout; older Computerwoche coverage identifies Krefeld among Deutsche Telekom Computer Service Management service/computer centers. No public MW found.
